{{Top|Reb}}

A '''Bounceback''' was a tightband feedback reflector that could reverb an energy beam back to the attacker. [[Kaird]] considered it when thinking of weapons to use against [[Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>
